outcome: amount of blood loss during delivery
frequency of abnormal hemorrhage at delivery
cohort: The study included 27 women with singleton pregnancies diagnosed with low-lying placenta who delivered between January 2012 and December 2021.
finding: The occurrence of warning bleeding significantly increased the amount of blood loss and frequency of abnormal hemorrhage during delivery in patients with low-lying placenta.
mod_finding: The planned delivery mode showed no statistically significant impact on the amount of blood loss or frequency of abnormal hemorrhage at delivery.
